issues.on_page: Statement of Cash Flows - Proprietary Funds, Total enterprise: operating 1,516,029; noncapital financing 366,384; capital and related financing (354,145); investing (2,258,428); cash beginning 2,176,255; ending 1,446,095 (p13)
issues.issue: Basis is recorded as 'cash' because governmental funds are modified cash, but the enterprise funds are full accrual and a printed proprietary cash flow statement exists (pp12-13). proprietary is left null, so these figures aren't captured. A mixed-basis judgment call; the user may want them recorded.

issues.on_page: Report pages 17, 19 and 59 are not in the trimmed PDF (trimmed p5 = report p16, p6 = p18, p17 = p58, p18 = p60)
issues.issue: Pp17/19 are probably the governmental-fund reconciliations (no new lines). P59 sits between the Economic Development budget schedule and the nonmajor combining statement, so it may be another schedule (for example a Bond Fund budget schedule or a nonmajor combining balance sheet). All totals in the trimmed pages tie, so nothing is shown to be missing; check the source PDF.

Label is explicit (repayments of economic development loans), not an unexplained 'other'. No listed category fits exactly, so 'other' with review is defensible; also detail[127] (miscellaneous revenue). This is 2% of governmental receipts.
Keno community-betterment spending could arguably go to culture/recreation or economic development; 'other' with review is a judgment call. Same for detail[129].

issues.on_page: Cemetery department column (187,954 total), shown under Public works on the governmental funds statement
issues.issue: The category rules list cemetery under health/welfare, but the department-column rule says the split must tie to the statement's functions (Public works 187,954). The extractor chose to tie to the statement and marked every Cemetery line review (detail[106]-[115]); defensible but conflicting rules.

issues.on_page: Grant income 10,000 (Water Fund, nonoperating); Statement of Activities shows it as Capital Grants and Contributions (p3); cash flow 'Grant proceeds' under capital financing
issues.issue: Source of the grant (federal, state or other) isn't printed; 'federal grants' is a guess, already marked review. It is a capital grant, so it could arguably be business_type.other_financing instead of a receipt.
